title: Yellow Smoky Indian Mackerel Korma
description: A smoky and crumbly Indian dish featuring mackerel, ferment-kimchi, and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, all combined in a delicious korma form, grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, ghee or oil, garam masala, smoked paprika, and salt.
Add the mackerel fillets to the bowl and coat with the yogurt mixture, making sure they are fully covered.
Grill the mackerel fillets for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
While the mackerel is cooking, heat the ferment-kimchi in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the mackerel is done, place it on a serving platter and spoon the warmed ferment-kimchi over the top.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
Serve with basmati rice or naan bread for a complete meal.
Refrigerate any leftovers and consume within 2 days.
